title_cyr: Сношти те пратив на вода ќерко
title_latin: Snošti te prativ na voda ḱerko
title_en: Last night I sent you for water, daughter

lines.cyr: - Сношти те пратив на вода ќерко,
lines.lat: - Snošti te prativ na voda ḱerko,
lines.en: - Last night I sent you for water, daughter,
but who broke your water jugs?
- It was dark and I couldn’t see, mama.
and it seemed like my sweetheart.
- Wait my daughter, wait for a while
at least until your father comes home.

lines.cyr: - Татко ми пошол, не дошол, леле,
lines.lat: - Tatko mi pošol, ne došol, lele,
lines.en: - Whether father comes, or not,
the bad news will get to him anyway [that I am married]!
- Wait, my daughter, wait for a while,
at least until your brother comes home.

lines.cyr: - Братот ми пошол, не дошол, леле,
lines.lat: - Bratot mi pošol, ne došol, lele,
lines.en: - Whether brother comes, or not,
the bad news will get to him anyway.

lines.cyr: Давај ме мамо, за него мори,
lines.lat: Davaj me mamo, za nego mori,
lines.en: Let me marry him, mama,

lines.cyr: зар сама ќ' одам по него.
lines.lat: zar sama ḱ' odam po nego.
lines.en: or else I’ll go after him myself.

lines.cyr: - Ти беше сношти на вода, Сирме,
lines.lat: - Ti beše snošti na voda, Sirme,
lines.en: - You were at the water last night, Sirma,
but who broke your water jugs?
- It was dark and I couldn’t see, mama.
There were too many, and I didn’t recognize them.

lines.cyr: - Как' да го видов, мајко ле мила,
lines.lat: - Kak' da go vidov, majko le mila,
lines.en: - How could I see him, dear mother,
and it seemed like my sweetheart.

lines.cyr: Как' да ми беше либето, мајко,
lines.lat: Kak' da mi beše libeto, majko,
lines.en: As if it were my sweetheart, mother,
with his faithful company.

lines.cyr: Со тенка пушка на рамо, мајко,
lines.lat: So tenka puška na ramo, majko,
lines.en: With a thin rifle on his shoulder, mother,
with a sharp sword at his belt.

lines.cyr: Давај ме мајко, за него леле,
lines.lat: Davaj me majko, za nego lele,
lines.en: Let me marry him, mama,

lines.cyr: или сама ќ' одам по него.
lines.lat: ili sama ḱ' odam po nego.
lines.en: or else I’ll go after him myself.
- Wait, wait until evening, daughter,

lines.cyr: барем да си дојде татко ти.
lines.lat: barem da si dojde tatko ti.
lines.en: at least until your father comes home.

lines.cyr: - Татко ми дошел, не дошел мајко,
lines.lat: - Tatko mi došel, ne došel majko,
lines.en: - Whether father comes, or not,
the bad news will get to him anyway [that I am married]!
